observation:
Direct observations: The open menu (white, rounded, at the lower-left) shows both demo entries fully readable — "Desk preview (local only)" and the checked "Desk preview alt (local only)", each wrapping to two lines. Alignment looks consistent; no left/right clipping.

At the bottom, no footer/summary row text is discernible below the second entry. The menu's lower edge sits flush against the image's bottom border (~y 843), so any bottom row appears cut off or outside the captured frame. Inference: the menu's declared overflow ("hidden auto") and its 112px height suggest content may scroll internally, so a footer could be hidden below the fold — I cannot confirm this without interacting.

The menu also overlays underlying page text; that's expected overlay behavior.
